title: Ondo rolling stats
description: A quiet white band of three giant figures: a two-tone heading on the left half, and in the right half three rows each holding a 150px tightly tracked numeral with a two-line grey serif label beside its foot, divided by hairlines. As each row scrolls into view its digits roll up through 0–9 to their value, like an odometer. On phones the heading sits on top and the numerals drop to 96px.
notes: the roll is a CSS scroll-driven animation: browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the final figures
labels read var(--ondo-serif) and fall back to the display face in other themes
name: ondo-stats
